sentence_translation.jp: 触れ合えば指先が熱くて
sentence_translation.en: When we touch, our fingertips are hot, and…

meaning_note: People depend on context; て leaves this thought unfinished.

phrase_breakdown.explanation: 触れ合う means ‘touch each other.’ ば makes it ‘if/when.’
が marks fingertips as what the adjective describes.
The connecting form of 熱い, ‘hot,’ linking to what follows.

main_takeaway: 触れ合えば sets the condition; 指先が熱くて describes what happens under it.
